messages:
tom: Quick note from today's onboarding: sample README shows different auth patterns across snippets (curl uses 'Token', Node uses RW_API_KEY). New users hit 401s.
megan: Can you paste the exact curl and node lines?
tom: curl: `-H 'Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_API_KEY'`
node: `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })`
megan: Oh wow. Proposed minimal fix: unify to REDWOOD_API_KEY and use 'Bearer' header. Also change RW_API_KEY occurrences to REDWOOD_API_KEY.
megan: I'll open a small PR to update snippets, add a PowerShell vs bash note, and add a docs-lint rule for 'Authorization: Token' and legacy RW_* keys. Want me to backport to v1-readme too?
tom: Yes please, backport and ping Support once deployed.
docs-bot: Current README: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/samples/sample-app/README.md
megan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301 - tiny README fixes + lint rule. CI running.
lint-bot: docs-lint: snippet-check queued for PR 1301. Will flag deprecated auth prefixes if present.
